title: ICT 基礎
subtitle: ICT Basics
courseType:
Practical Engineering Education Program
Practical Engineering Education Courses
educationalGoal: -To understand the structure of personal computers (PCs) and their capabilities and possibilities. -To gain the basic abilities to utilize a personal computer as a student and as a member of society, including education, research, and technical development.
advice: In this course, you will learn the following basic knowledge to use your personal computer (laptop computer) for study and student life. 1. Basic PC operation: Learn basic operations such as Windows operation and software installation. 2. Network operation: Learn how to set up connection to on-campus and off-campus networks, how to view on-campus and off-campus web pages, how to use the on-campus web systems, knowledge and information about network security and anti-virus software, manners when using networks. 3. Office software operation: Learn basic skills in document creation / spreadsheet / presentation material creation. 4. Data handling skills: Learn data handling skills using spreadsheet software.
requiredKnowledge: No prior knowledge or skills are assumed. The exercises will use your own laptop computer. Be sure to bring your laptop computer, power adapter, and network cable (LAN cable) with your course.

activityGoals.body: To be able to understand the basic knowledge of personal computers and usage of laptop computers.
To be able to understand the basic knowledge of Windows and use Windows and applications that run on Windows.
To be able to understand how to install the software and make your PC available for use at our university.
To be able to understand the mechanism of virus infection and protect your computer from computer viruses.
To be able to set up a network settings and use the campus network.
To be able to operate Office software and make effective use of data.

achievementLevels.ideal: To understand the capabilities of computers and select appropriate functions to respond to various hardware and software problems. To use the most appropriate software and utilize its functions when solving a problem.
achievementLevels.standard: To manage your computer every day. To use Windows, Word, Excel and PowerPoint for your purposes.

lessons.content: 【Network settings orientation ①】 PC settings, Windows, Information literacy (Part 1) ・Guidance (overview of classes and schedule) ・Explanation of PC hardware (textbook 1.2) ・Laptop setup ・Windows Part 1 (1.3) ・How to use the wired campus network (Appendix 1) ・How to use the campus email (Appendix 6) ・How to browse and use the campus web systems (Appendix 3) ・How to use the remote-VPN service (Appendix 6)
lessons.operation: Lecture and exercise using a laptop computer
lessons.assignments: If you cannot finish the setting / exercise in the class, you have to deal with it by yourself until the next class.

lessons.content: 【Network settings orientation ②】 PC settings, Windows, Information literacy (Part 2) ・Windows Part 2 (1.4) ・Installation of Microsoft Office (Appendix 5) ・How to use cloud storage service "Box" (Append ix 6) ・How to use web meeting service "Zoom"
lessons.operation: Lecture and exercise using a laptop computer
lessons.assignments: If you cannot finish the setting / exercise in the class, you have to deal with it by yourself until the next class.

lessons.content: PC settings, Windows, Information literacy (Part 3) ・Japanese input (1.5) ・Touch typing (1.6) ・Folder / File operation (1.7) ・Exercise of report submission (Appendix 3) ・How to use the wifi campus network(Appendix 6) ・Installation of anti-virus software (Appendix 4)
lessons.operation: Lecture and exercise using a laptop computer
lessons.assignments: If you cannot finish the setting / exercise in the class, you have to deal with it by yourself until the next class.

lessons.content: PC settings, Windows, Information literacy (Part 4) ・Information literacy (2.1-2.7) ・Network printer settings (Appendix 2) ・Check account list (Appendix 7) ・Review the class Presentation of the first report assignment
lessons.operation: Lecture and exercise using a laptop computer
lessons.assignments: If you cannot finish the setting / exercise in the class, you will have to deal with it by yourself until the next class. In addition, we look back on the contents so far and aim to establish them.

lessons.content: Word (Part 1) ・Starting and closing Word, create and save new files, load and save existing files, basic window operations, page settings ・Editing operation ① (Range selection, move / copy)
lessons.operation: Lecture and exercise using a laptop computer
lessons.assignments: Understand the contents of the exercise in advance and confirm the location of the sample file for the exercise. Review with preliminary exercises.

lessons.content: Word (Part 2) ・Editing operation ② (font, center alignment, insertion of word art, insertion of figure), printing ・Editing operation ③ (Figures, text boxes, columns, footnotes) ・ Basic table operations (creation, insertion, editing, deletion)
lessons.operation: Lecture and exercise using a laptop computer
lessons.assignments: Understand the contents of the exercise in advance and confirm the location of the sample file for the exercise. Review with preliminary exercises.

lessons.content: Word (Part 3) ・Word search and replacement, formula input, and other functions (bullet, table of contents, header, footer, help function) Presentation of the 2nd report assignment
lessons.operation: Lecture and exercise using a laptop computer
lessons.assignments: Look through the relevant part of the textbook. Review the content of previous learning and exercises about Word.

lessons.content: Excel (Part 1) ・Starting and closing Excel, basic operation ・Table creation (Formulas, sums, units, cell widths, formatting, cell references)
lessons.operation: Lecture and exercise using a laptop computer
lessons.assignments: Read the basic editing operations such as the names and uses of each part of the Excel window, copying and moving data, and adding and deleting cells and rows. After the class, review the contents of the exercise.

lessons.content: Excel (Part 2) ・Data entry and worksheet ・Insert function
lessons.operation: Lecture and exercise using a laptop computer
lessons.assignments: Read the textbook to see what functions are available. After the class, review the contents of the exercise.

lessons.content: Excel (Part 3) ・Relative and absolute references ・Create graph ・Print tables and graphs
lessons.operation: Lecture and exercise using a laptop computer
lessons.assignments: Read the textbook on how to display tabular data as a graph. Check the contents of the learning so far in preparation for the quiz.

lessons.content: Excel (Part 4) ・Operation of multiple books ・Merge printing ・Image operations (about Paint) Excel comprehension quiz
lessons.operation: Lecture and exercise using a laptop computer Written test
lessons.assignments: Take a look at the textbook for other Excel features. Review the contents of previous learning and exercises about Excel.

lessons.content: Data handling skills (Part 1) ・Aggregation and graph creation of experimental results by Excel ・Analysis of experimental results by Excel
lessons.operation: Lecture and exercise using a laptop computer
lessons.assignments: Understand the contents of learning and exercises in advance using class materials. After class, reconfirm the contents of learning and exercises.

lessons.content: Data handling skills (Part 2) ・Questionnaire survey procedure and notes ・Aggregation and graph creation of questionnaire survey results creation by Excel ・Analysis of questionnaire survey results by Excel
lessons.operation: Lecture and exercise using a laptop computer
lessons.assignments: Understand the contents of learning and exercises in advance using class materials. After class, reconfirm the contents of learning and exercises.

lessons.content: Data handling skills (Part 3) ・Explanation of open data ・Aggregation and graph creation of open data by Excel ・Analysis of open data by Excel Presentation of the 3rd report assignment
lessons.operation: Lecture and exercise using a laptop computer
lessons.assignments: Understand the contents of learning and exercises in advance using class materials. Review the contents of previous learning and exercises on data handling skills.

lessons.content: PowerPoint ・Starting and closing PowerPoint ・Operation of presentation ・Insertion of various objects on slides ・Slideshow operation ・Print presentation Self-check, Course questionnaire
lessons.operation: Lecture and exercise using a laptop computer
lessons.assignments: Review the relevant sections of the textbook for PowerPoint features and basic operations. Inspect each item of the achievement goal and learn about the items with low achievement.
